01
A proposal by Ian Allan, Founder, Saved.

Diploma in Resilient Technologies

Technology education and the fight for the East Coast, and any constrained region where the standard tech stack doesn’t serve.

L5NZQCF Level 120Credits 8Credentials 1 yrDuration
02
The problem

Converging technology pressures

Digital rents keep rising

Market-leading online services are heavily subsidised by investor capital. And when that bargain ends the services get worse, the rent goes up, and inequalities are exacerbated.

Regions are precarious

We can't take connectivity, power, or corporate goodwill for granted. Climate events, isolation, and economic imbalances mean resilience has to be built locally.

AI has upended things

Students must be AI-fluent to be employable, while the same tools are pushing down on the entry-level roles they’re training for.

03
The opportunity

There is no qualification like this yet

Imagine the technologist who can reclaim machines, stand up their own servers, host their own AI models, integrate physical sensors, fly drones, and configure solar; all in service of their community.

That person has no tertiary pathway in Aotearoa yet.

04
The solution

Introducing the diploma

A studio-based programme where graduates can build, own, and operate resilient technologies for themselves and their communities.

L5NZQCF Level
120Credits
8Credentials
1 yrDuration
05
How it works

The studio model

A shared space and a tight group challenging one another with the same rhythm as a design or maker studio.

DeliveryStudio-based, project-centred
Structure2 semesters · 8 credentials × 15 credits
AssessmentLive demonstration, Q&A, real-time modification, real deployment
ArticulationPathway to Level 6/7
06
Semester one — Sovereign Self

Own your computing

C1
Foundations

Reclaim a machine, migrate off dependency.

C2
Open Operating Systems

Linux, from daily-driver to self-hosted server.

C3
Applied Open Source AI

Run your own models, own your data.

C4
Open Web Fundamentals

Build and deploy real sites, no lock-in.

07
Semester two — Sovereign Service

Serve your region

C5
Physical Computing & Sensing

Low-cost sensing, deployed and connected.

C6
Fabrication & Electronics

Circuits, soldering, 3D printing, real builds.

C7
Community Energy Systems

Off-grid solar to community micro-grids.

C8
Aerial Operations

Lawful drone flying, mapping briefs.

08
Assessment

Proof in doing

AI has broken conventional written assessment, and not everyone's academically-minded anyway. So in this diploma every credential is assessed the same way:

Live demonstrations, professional conversations, real-time modifications, real deployments.

You can’t fake showing up and explaining your own work.

09
Graduate outcomes

Graduates with real skills, ready to go

  • Advocate for sovereignty
  • Own and operate open systems
  • Build on the open web
  • Deploy sovereign AI
  • Build for the physical and remote
  • Deliver for real communities
  • Be a professional

Plus a pathway to a future Level 6/7 qualification in resilient, applied computer engineering.
